answer: The umber assignment is published and raven records each panel. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the nebula graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 2695 identities would post 4123 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
